Exercise: Weighted Sissy Squat

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
expert

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_lower_body_push

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings

Equipment:

- barbell

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- quadriceps_hypertrophy
- glute_activation_and_strength

Contraindications:

- Recent knee surgery
- Severe hip or lower back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Weighted Sissy Squat with Kettlebell, equipment: kettlebell
- name: Single-Leg Barbell Deadlift, equipment: barbell

Substitution Options:

- name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift with Dumbbell, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Standing upright, with feet at shoulder width and toes raised, use one hand to hold onto the beams of a squat rack and the opposite arm to hold a plate on top of your chest. This is your starting position.
- As you use one arm to hold yourself, bend at the knees and slowly lower your torso toward the ground by bringing your pelvis and knees forward. Inhale as you go down and stop when your upper and lower legs almost create a 90-degree angle. Hold the stretch position for a second.
- After your one second hold, use your thigh muscles to bring your torso back up to the starting position. Exhale as you move up.
- Repeat for the recommended amount of times.
